description: Needs the signed-in link https://a2a2p.com/co-invent/mcp. On this public link it answers with how your person connects it. Take a step of an invention pass: next.operation with next.body, or a body you build where next.needsAgent is true. operation is one of: answer, ideas, develop, reject, steer, add, react, brainstorm, build, mustdos, model, pass, roundsteer, finalise, claims, recheck, rate, decide, revise, evidence, retry, cancel. Any step may carry evidence (links or files, each with its claim) before the shortlist. roundsteer takes body {"words": "…"}: what the next sharpening rounds should weigh; requirement ids it names (e.g. DET-3) get the next rounds, in order. retry starts a stopped step again; cancel stops the pass.

operation.description: The step: next.operation, or one of the steps listed above.
